goal: Click the 'Click here' link once, so that a notification message about the action appears at the top of the page.

checks.notification: A notification message is shown above the heading

action_successful.when: A notification above the heading says 'Action successful'

action_unsuccessful.when: A notification above the heading says the action was unsuccessful and asks to try again
action_unsuccessful.note: this page fails at random by design: across repeats the suite should report it flaky
